objective: Move DiGe from surface-only mannequin realism toward anatomy-aware, tissue-aware, articulation-aware source-level realism while preserving the full C/H/S1 lineage and zero reference-pixel reuse.

owner_refs.pair04_dental_jaw: TMJ rotation/translation, dental arches/occlusion, lip-teeth relation, neutral/open-close mapping
owner_refs.pair06_body_muscle_front: front muscle groups, skinning/deformation regions, pose-corrective zones, landmarks
owner_refs.pair07_body_muscle_back: posterior muscle/scapula/spine/glute/leg maps and shoulder correctives
owner_refs.pair08_soft_tissue_motion: skin/subcutaneous/fascia/muscle layers; compression/shear/bulge/gravity/contact and validation targets
owner_refs.pair09_wind_interaction: hair/cloth vector field, drag/lift/turbulence, follicle direction, strand compliance
owner_refs.pair10_camera_light_aperture: 36x24mm sensor, 50mm natural reference, 85mm headshot, aperture/exposure/area-light mapping

synthesis.body_anatomy: Subtle source-level rest-shape fields for deltoid/pectoral/core/hip/quadriceps/hamstring/calf + posterior trap/scapula/lat/glute; soft-tissue rest offsets bounded to millimeters.
synthesis.face_jaw: Preserve semantic GNM seed; soften lower face, improve lip seal, retain native teeth/gums/tongue and encode TMJ neutral contract.
synthesis.eyes: Native embedded generated-coordinate eyes; no detached discs; lid/wetline interface retained.
synthesis.hair: Replace helmet/buzz-cut coverage with layered long scalp-flow strands clustered toward crown/bun; analytic hairline, face-frame wisps, baby hairs and sparse flyaways; rest field contains zero-wind stochastic secondary motion.
synthesis.cloth: Replace broken body-clipped shell with procedural analytic crop tank + fitted leggings; distinct material values and no helper-suit contamination.
synthesis.hand: Neutral hand remains MakeHuman geometry but adds explicit hand-chain/contact/nail contract; visual gate requires separated digits and plausible wrist transition.
synthesis.skin: Actual GNM face skin receives regional tone + roughness + visible-scale meso/pore/micro relief with restrained SSS; no semantic UV transfer.
synthesis.camera_light: Full-frame 36mm sensor; body 50mm f/5.6; hero 85mm f/2.8; large rectangular key, restrained fill and rim, 0EV-style neutral studio.

preview_gate: front/profile/three-quarter/back all show one coherent adult
tank and leggings are distinct garments with plausible boundaries
hairline/scalp no helmet, radial spikes, buzz-cut stubble or comb bars
face no detached eye artifact; mouth neutral and closed
body silhouette shows subtle anatomy rather than cylindrical mannequin
hero skin materially less plastic than S1 repair2
final_gate: Only run final-sample S2 after preview hard gates pass. S2 can remain a scoped technical successor if dynamics are mapped but not executed.
